title: Sunda Kelapa Lighthouse
geometryBasis: OSM way 1359868373 wraps the existing stone shaft at the verified Sunda Kelapa Lighthouse location. The historic photograph identifies its gallery and lantern, and the modern navigation survey gives its 16 m height.
sectionBasis: The 1875 Woodbury and Page waterfront photograph shows the tapered shaft, two round windows, corbelled gallery and glazed cylinder. The mapped shaft is approximately 3.55 m across.
limitations: The lantern railing, paint weathering and the masonry entrance orientation are approximations. The 1875 photograph is the visual basis for the upper lantern.
The wharf sheds and modern port buildings are outside the scope.
